title: Choose the dark jet world
question: The roll assigned The Night Hall. Keep it, take the pick, or re-roll.

options.label: The Night Hall
options.lineage: aviation museum halls after dark: a black aircraft under gallery spotlights, Smithsonian object labels
options.thesis: Your work shown the way a great hall shows its one black aircraft: in hard light, with a precise label, and nothing else.
options.viewport: A black hall. One hard spotlight falls on your photo, graded black and white and cut out of the dark. Beside it, a museum label: Aryan Haghighi, AI Engineer, the claim, the drone line, then email, LinkedIn and GitHub. The jet mark hangs high as the hall's one object. The How I work bay is already lit at the fold.
options.risk: Soft light makes a hall feel like a memorial; it needs hard light and crisp labels to feel alive. Aircraft must stay out of the pictures (the jet is only the mark) or it drifts toward an aerospace CV.

raised.raise: Two-state light: everything is lit or unlit with a hard edge, no grey haze anywhere.
One governing curve: the jet mark's blended leading edge is the line the hero composition follows.
No boxes, rules or dividers: grouping comes only from pools of light.
Every exhibit carries the identical label format, so the eye compares them down the hall.
Exhibits stand in one ordered row read in sequence, never a grid of cards.
One decisive beat per page: a single exhibit breaks out of its bay.

options.label: Black Livery
options.lineage: the SR-71's matte black paint and its small white and red stencil markings
options.thesis: The page is the skin of a matte black jet: your name painted like a tail marking, everything else as crisp stencils.
options.viewport: Full-bleed matte black. Your name large in wide caps like a tail marking, the claim and links as precise stencil lines, the photo in black and white set into the skin like a panel.
options.risk: Most runs on a jet theme land here. Stencil type tips into costume or a military look fast, which is the aerospace-CV read you want to avoid.

options.label: Weimar Cabaret Bill
options.lineage: Berlin cabaret bills, two harsh inks
options.case: Fuses onto dark well, but leaning expressionist type breaks the calm, sharp voice founders should meet; loses both axes.
options.kept: Total two-state lighting: lit or unlit, no midtones.

options.label: Curved Crease Shell
options.case: Cream paper fights the dark theme you pinned; nothing in it says speed or night; loses both axes.
options.kept: One governing curve instead of a rectangular grid.

options.label: Struck Cathode Gauze
options.case: Dark and hot like the theme, but ghosted options blur a 5-second scan and read as retro tech, not jets; loses both axes.
options.kept: No boxes or rules: grouping by depth and light only.

options.label: VU Meter Bridge
options.case: Would want eval numbers that do not exist yet, and an instrument row reads as a cockpit costume; loses both axes.
options.kept: Identical units repeated as the row's own ruler.

options.label: Glaze River Shelf
options.case: Craft ceramics share nothing with jets or AI agents; loses both axes.
options.kept: Samples ranked in one ordered row, gravity setting the reading order.

options.label: Manga Screentone Page
options.case: Speed lines fit the theme, but a comic page undercuts a serious engineer; loses both axes.
options.kept: Solid black reserved for the one decisive beat.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark personal portfolio: photo, name, claim, links, sections below, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Photo and name side by side, claim and links under the name, sections in a single column below.
canonCard.risk: Safe and clear, and indistinguishable from every other engineer's site; the jet theme becomes a logo only.
